recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel vertical composition featuring a central high-contrast sepia photograph of three women in a garden setting, framed by top and bottom horizontal bands of aged, textured parchment paper containing elegant serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast yellow-sepia image against neutral off-white parchment borders
Symmetrical typographic layout with flanking decorative flourishes
Triangular arrangement of subjects within the central frame
Textured, weathered paper effect unifying the top and bottom margins
coreInvariants: Heavy yellow-gold tint on the central photograph
Black horizontal divider lines separating the image from the borders
Wide tracking in the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a staggered vertical line: one standing left, one standing center-back, one sitting foreground-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central standing figure provides the vertical axis, while the large display text at the top anchors the branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top display text, down the vertical line of the subjects, to the subtitle text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the parchment borders creates a clean, classic framing effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard-yellow and sepia tones define the central photographic area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the divider lines and high-contrast shadows in the photo.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark teal or charcoal for the typography and decorative flourishes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow mid-tones of the photo; low saturation in the desaturated parchment borders.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif with high stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, all-caps serif for the primary title paired with a delicate, lowercase italic serif for the secondary text.
graphicDevices: Symmetrical leaf/vine flourishes flanking the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant serifs of the display text.
Provides the soft, classical feel needed for the lowercase subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of three women in a lush garden with stone steps, heavily filtered in a monochromatic yellow-sepia tone. Place this image in the center of a square canvas, framed by off-white textured parchment borders at the top and bottom, separated by thin black horizontal lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, all-caps serif title in the top border with extreme tracking, flanked by two small leaf flourishes. Add a smaller, lowercase italic serif subtitle in the bottom border with even wider tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the central image monochromatic yellow-sepia?
Are there clear black divider lines between the image and borders?
Is the typography centered with wide tracking?
Does the top border contain decorative flourishes?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow color cast
Amount of texture on the parchment borders
Specific style of the floral flourishes
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the sepia tone doesn't wash out the subjects' features.
Verify the parchment texture looks organic and not repetitive.
Confirm the horizontal lines are crisp and solid black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central high-contrast monochromatic photo + horizontal black dividers + textured parchment headers/footers + wide-tracked classical serif typography.
